population: All unique AST single-site substitutions from the existing synthetic target function, without using MR detection outputs to select mutants
evaluation: All eight existing admissible operators, three pre-existing source cases per operator, no mutation-output-based selection
baseline: Standalone manually specified operator-specific source transformations and relation comparators, independently written, not importing generated MR transform/oracle
eligibility: Reference pairs must satisfy relation before mutation is scored; invalid and unresolved separate; no cherry picking
scoring: A kill requires a known valid source/follow-up relation and a FALSE relation on mutated target outputs; source-only changes do not count
equivalence: Distinguished from exact-output divergence over evaluation inputs; not global mutant equivalence
limits: Synthetic target, authorship not blinded, requirements adapted to same domains, constructed fixtures
